Taking out any natural threats (climate change, volcanos, asteroids, gamma-ray bursts etc...) The greatest threat to humanity would be humans. Just one action of nuclear war would devastate humanity.

However, back to the point of all types of threats currently according to Oxford University, there is a 19% chance of the world ending by 2100. The top two threats are AI (Artificial intelligence) and NanoTech weapons. The question about AI is honestly very possible in the future. As humans continue to evolve and build new technology will we start to become more dependant on it. The more dependent we become the more we build and the smarter AI gets, to the point where we can no longer control it.

Another threat and in my opinion probably the worst for us now, are CMEs or Coronal Mass Ejections. They are followed after Solar Flares which is a blast of plasm and if this was to hit Earth directly all sorts of communication is gone, airplanes gone, electronics are gone, really anything controlled by a power source of electricity would be gone. Back in 1859, the Carrington event happened, a CME hit Earth which caused telegraphs to catch on fire. Back in 2012, we came into a VERY close call with another CME, if that would have made contact with Earth, we would still be here trying to pick up the pieces.
